exposure: intra-amniotic inflammation without microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity (MIAC)
cohort: Pregnant patients with singleton pregnancies admitted for preterm premature rupture of membranes, preterm labor, cervical insufficiency, or asymptomatic cervical shortening between 22 and 33 gestational weeks.
finding: The risk of bronchopulmonary dysplasia was significantly increased in patients with intra-amniotic infection with Ureaplasma species, but not in those with intra-amniotic infection without Ureaplasma species or intra-amniotic inflammation without MIAC.
